---
title: Program Requirements
---

Members of our group can be students in several different fields, which have slightly different requirements. There are also many possible minors that students can take. This section consolidates some guidance and requirements and points to more official documentation.

The group also keeps a [course list with possible sequences](https://github.com/srikrishnan-lab/class-list) of classes lab members have found useful. Check the dates on it before relying on a listing -- course numbers and offerings change, and the [Courses of Study](https://classes.cornell.edu/) roster is authoritative.
